Class AlgoHistoricalValuationService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoHistoricalValuationService
@Service @Transactional(readOnly=true) public class AlgoHistoricalValuationService extends Object
Historical closing equity and gross exposure. Each account and each margin opening remains separate until valuation is complete. No live quote or missing-data substitution is permitted.

    • valueSeries

      public Map<LocalDate, AlgoHistoricalValuationService.Snapshot> valueSeries(Integer idTenant, Collection<LocalDate> dates, AlgoHistoricalValuationService.ClosingPrices market, Map<Integer,Security> securities)
      Computes reporting equity after all bookings have finished. Holding periods and cash balances are each read once; settlement-account attribution is unnecessary for these totals. Margin lots retain their existing calculation, using one bounded ledger read for the entire series. Prices remain bounded by each observation date.
